description: Hands access is gated by measured capacity. Use when a Hands call returns a request_hands_access next_action (hands_access_required). action=request joins the user's queue (idempotent) and keeps resume_ref so you can retry the refused call once admitted; pass invite_code to use an invite, which skips the queue once. action=status returns state (waitlisted, invited, active), the position and estimate computed from real data (null when not measured), the published rules that move the user up, and admitted=true when you can resume.

invite_code.description: Request: an invite code the user was given

resume_ref.description: Request: the task_ref from the refused call, returned again as resume once admitted
